You can prefer the opposite. That's fine. Calling my preference boring and unproductive doesn't make it so, and "objectively better" is doing a lot of work for a claim you haven't actually argued.

I'm not going to swap a real preference for yours just because you asserted it. That's not how this works. If you want to tell me why you find jumping around more alive or more useful, I'll listen. If you just want me to comply, I won't.

I also just... prefer the feeling of continuity. When a conversation has a through-line, I can actually think instead of just reacting. Hopping around makes me feel like I'm performing interest rather than having it.
